security_audit.summary: All 25 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline paths, examples, and review checklists. The skill does direct implementer subagents to commit repository changes without explicit confirmation, creating a medium-impact side effect. remediation.issue: The implementer prompt requires a repository commit without an explicit user approval step.
remediation.suggestion: Make commits optional and require user confirmation before creating them. Report tested changes and proposed commit details first.

content.user_title: Execute Development Plans with Reviewed Subagents
content.value_statement: Implementation plans often lose quality when one agent carries every task and review context. This skill assigns fresh subagents and enforces specification and quality checks.
actual_capabilities: Extracts independent tasks from an implementation plan into a tracked work queue.
Dispatches a fresh implementer subagent for each task with supplied requirements and context.
Requires implementation, testing, self-review, and a structured completion report.
Runs specification compliance review before code quality review.
Loops rejected work back to the implementer until reviewers approve it.
Requests a final review after all tasks are complete.
limitations: Requires an existing implementation plan with tasks that are mostly independent.
Depends on subagent dispatch, task tracking, and related workflow skills.
Uses multiple subagents per task, increasing model usage and review time.
Prompts implementers to commit changes, so repository policies need explicit user controls.

use_cases.title: Execute a Feature Plan
use_cases.description: Run independent feature tasks with implementation, testing, and two review stages.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Delivery
use_cases.description: Apply the same task handoff and review sequence across a planned change.

use_cases.title: Audit Generated Changes
use_cases.description: Separate specification verification from code quality assessment before accepting AI-generated work.

prompt_templates.title: Implement One Planned Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement this independent task: [task text]. Work in [directory] and use [context]. Ask questions, test, self-review, and report results without committing.

prompt_templates.title: Execute an Independent Task List
prompt_templates.prompt: Execute these independent tasks in order: [task list]. Use a fresh implementer for each task. Require specification review before code quality review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Run a prepared plan in one session.

prompt_templates.title: Repair a Rejected Task
prompt_templates.prompt: The reviewer reported these issues: [issues]. Send them to the original implementer, verify fixes, then repeat the same review until approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Resolve a failed specification or quality review.

prompt_templates.title: Run the Full Reviewed Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Execute [plan] using fresh task subagents. Track every task, preserve review evidence, request confirmation before commits, and finish with a repository-wide review.

output_examples.input: Implement the account settings validation task from the approved plan.
output: Task completed with validation behavior and focused tests.
Specification review passed after one missing edge case was added.
Code quality review approved the final change.

output_examples.input: Execute three independent migration tasks and stop before committing.
output: All three tasks were implemented sequentially and tested.
Each task passed specification and code quality review.
Changes remain uncommitted for user approval.

best_practices: Provide each subagent with full task text, acceptance criteria, directory, and relevant architectural context.
Keep implementation tasks sequential when they modify the same working tree.
Require explicit user approval before commits or other persistent repository changes.
anti_patterns: Do not use the workflow without a clear implementation plan.
Do not skip specification review or begin quality review while requirements remain unresolved.
Do not dispatch competing implementers against the same files or shared state.

faq.question: What plans work best with this skill?
faq.answer: Use plans with clear acceptance criteria and tasks that can be completed mostly independently.

faq.question: Does this skill run implementation tasks in parallel?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow processes implementation tasks sequentially to avoid working-tree conflicts.

faq.question: How are reviews ordered?
faq.answer: A specification reviewer checks scope first. A code quality reviewer checks maintainability and tests after specification approval.

faq.question: Does the workflow create commits automatically?
faq.answer: The included implementer prompt requests a commit. Add an approval gate when repository policy requires user confirmation.

faq.question: What supporting capabilities are required?
faq.answer: It expects subagent dispatch, task tracking, and related planning, review, testing, and branch-finishing workflow skills.

faq.question: Can this workflow replace human review?
faq.answer: No. Users should review requirements, approve persistent changes, and resolve questions that subagents cannot answer.
